Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Keep the order meaningful — time or rank; never alphabetical.
Overlap ≤ 50% of the ridge height so peaks remain readable.
Same x scale and same bandwidth for every ridge.
Max 12 ridges; beyond that use Horizon or a heatmap.
Overlap is the point
Ridgelines save space by overlapping; the knockout layer (surface/card) keeps each curve crisp in Light and Dark.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
Field
Definition
Purpose
Stacked, slightly overlapping density curves — shows how a distribution shifts across ordered groups (months, cohorts, versions).
Encoding
y = ordered group (band, overlapping), x = value (linear), ridge height = kernel density (shared bandwidth). Colour only for highlight.
Interaction
Hover → tooltip (n, median, P90). Click label → highlight that group. Keyboard: arrow keys between ridges.
Accessibility
aria-label per ridge with median and P90; data table fallback; highlight also uses label weight, not only colour.
